messages:
Alex: ran an nsys capture on dev-cluster (4xA100) -- default kernel selector. saw KV-cache miss wave ~18-22s into trace; queue time spiking.
Maria: can you paste the timeline top kernels? curious if matmul launch tail or host queuing.
Alex: top kernels (summed):
```
matmul_fp16: 42.3ms
attention_forward: 18.7ms
kernel_launch_overhead: 7.8ms
kv_cache_lookup: 2.1ms
continuous_batch_window_eval: 9.6ms
```
Jit: hmm kernel_launch_overhead looks high. what's batching window config? default 16ms.
Alex: batch/window: continuous batching enabled, target_rt=40ms, max_window=64ms, observed effective window drifting to 80-120ms under load (so batch sizes grow). queue_time vs compute_time: queue_time peaked at 65% of total token latency during spikes.
Sasha: any evidence of prefetch sweep or KV LRU eviction? those can cause host stalls.
Alex: yes, perf trace shows periodic KV sweep tasks on CPU thread pool around same timestamps. logs:
```
[2026-02-15T12:03:18Z] kv_cache: sweep start shard=3 entries=512
[2026-02-15T12:03:18Z] kv_cache: compaction done duration=48ms
```
Maria: compaction 48ms on host will block KV lookup hot path if we hold shard locks. that could stall request threads and increase queue time.
Jit: two ideas: 1) make compaction incremental (slice into 8ms chunks) 2) shift compaction to background worker with lock-free sampling.
Alex: tried incremental compaction in a small branch; reran nsys. queue_time drops ~30% and batch windows stabilized near 36ms. no regression in tail latency of matmul.
perf-bot: regression-check: compare p95 token latency: baseline 124ms -> branch 112ms (9.7% improvement). diff ok.
Sasha: good. next: kernel selector engaged different matmul kernel for larger batch sizes? any evidence of kernel switchover overhead?
Alex: yes, during window growth we saw kernel module reloads (kernel selection path switching) causing short pauses: host dispatch spikes ~12ms each switchover. patch idea: pre-warm alternative kernels and keep them resident.
Maria: let's schedule a canary with incremental compaction + kernel prewarming on staging for 24h. also add a perfetto capture around the compaction window.
Alex: will open PR and attach traces.
